split_rule.count: k=min(n_eligible_seen_cell,n_new_cell); select first k independently hash-ranked paths per side
split_rule.donors: hash-rank GG-fit speakers; first n(GG-val speakers), paired by independently ranked GG-val speakers
split_rule.fail: empty calibrator speaker, absent calibration class, lost donor in fit, non-disjoint roles, unequal cell counts
split_rule.seen_eligibility: first floor(n_donor/2) hash-ranked GG-fit donor recordings; the remainder is reserved for F
split_rule.strata: paired donor x sentence x label_index
split_rule.zero_cell: drop the entire cell on both sides; never substitute another cell
